dct_title_s: Burkina Faso health districts (districts de santé)
dct_description_sm: Burkina Faso health districts (districts de santé) P-coded and fitting below [Burkina Faso administrative level 0-3 boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/burkina-faso-administrative-boundaries) administrative level 2 (department). Example P-code: BFDS130001 BF is the ADM0_FR, representing Burkina Faso DS means "District de santé" 13 is from ADM1_PCODE BF13 00 is from ADM2_PCODE BF1300 01 means District de santé number 01 within BF1300
